theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PAccount1.router_accounting_order_discipline
theorems.doc:
/-- **P-ACCOUNT-1, abstract plane.**

On every committed execution of the modeled `handleOracleReport`, the
transaction step clock records both orderings:

1. the modeled router-balances write precedes the modeled rewards read;
2. the rewards read precedes any nonzero modeled fee mint.

These ticks do not establish that `sharesToMintAsFees` was computed from
the report, prestate or router distribution: it is still a caller-supplied
argument. The source's actual fee producer and public cross-contract
transport must be connected separately. In particular, ordering alone does
not prove that a minted amount uses the just-written module weights.

The ticks are `stampStep`'s reads of the transaction-local `sequenceSlot`
clock (reset at the top of the commit branch), not per-call-site constants,
so this is an ordering claim about execution and not about which numeral
appears on which line. Moving either the `stampStep balancesWrittenSlot`
call below `stampStep rewardsReadSlot`, or `stampStep rewardsReadSlot` below
`stampStep rewardsMintedSlot`, without touching any literal, changes the
tick the moved write records and refutes the corresponding conjunct — see
`write_router_before_read_kill_line` and `mint_order_kill_line` below. -/

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PAccount1.actual_report_accounting_call
theorems.doc:
/-- Actual physical-target legacy CALL, decoded immutable getter response
consumed by mint authorization after report/getter/checked fees, followed by
real payments and treasury STATICCALL. Full340/324 conclusions are retained
on the explicitly derived context. Effective deployed getter identity remains
a boundary; no frame, supplied auth equality or successful-stage premise. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem actual_report_accounting_call (accounting : AccountingCall.Environment)
    (treasury : TreasuryCall.Environment) (x : Input) (before post : World)
    (fee : FeeResult) (events : List Event) (payments : Payments) (treasuryAttempts : Attempts)
    (h : (execute accounting treasury x before).outcome =
      .committed post fee events payments treasuryAttempts) :
    Success accounting treasury x before post fee events payments treasuryAttempts
      (execute accounting treasury x before).accountingAttempts

reproduction.expected: Registered Verity parent actual_report_accounting_call builds: a committed report/fee execution satisfies Success (Prepared: balances written, distribution read from the written router state, checked fee from that distribution; nonzero fee resolves the accounting address and goes through the accounting call, payments and treasury STATICCALL; zero fee makes no accounting call), and actual_report_accounting_call_failure_restores builds (reverted execution restores the original world). Historical evidence: mint-after-read discipline over clock-stamped balance-write/read/mint ticks, with its pure call-site reordering kill-line on a valid nonempty report, plus the handleOracleReport-shaped Contract.run transaction and mutants

assumptions.risk: Canonical runtime, codehash, fork configuration, and address provenance are unavailable in general; Mock-derived evidence is non-production evidence. Chantier 4 (Thomas 2026-09-13) narrows this for two deployed-runtime fixtures under `fixtures/deployed/` to exact identifiers: `WithdrawalVault_implementation` at `0xfB4521BD151BFB45DB6045D2d07e58e0f597e340` with EIP-1052 codehash `0xd1e0d1b48e4f5abd04bdfd14805366f0cf7946b7bb41b7a5ad8652361f3e3d36` (mainnet, block-independent at any block where the immutable code has not been upgraded — the implementation slot on the WithdrawalVault_proxy `0xB9D7934878B5FB9610B3fE8A5e441e8fad7E293f` points at this deployed runtime, and the runtime is not upgradeable); `StakingRouter_implementation` at `0xDD76927045435C7605cf6f5F978cfb8CABDb5F80` with codehash `0x9cd5d45ddde5f74d3867aa22c98fd79a85df89d202145bc588173d92e00600ec` (same block-independence rationale). Under `ETH_RPC_URL`, the `verify_*_immutable.py` scripts re-fetch and re-verify against the live chain, so a mismatch fails the build; without `ETH_RPC_URL`, they enforce the pinned codehash. Step 1c (Thomas 2026-09-17) extends the fixtures to `fixtures/deployed/srv3-identities.json`, recording by EIP-1052 codehash the SRLib library linked into the router (`0xc0be9942fd8f54ab126a5f0ba649a90049ccad14`) with its 21 PUSH20 link sites, the BeaconChainDepositor library (`0xf98ac162eab766bdb9507c3584c00c535b8f6216`, 3 sites), the MinFirstAllocationStrategy library linked into SRLib (`0x98f1da239a199574a4f7f371fd8fc0a872022c73`, 1 site), the implementations behind the four registered staking modules (NodeOperatorsRegistry/SimpleDVT `0x6828b023e737f96b168acd0b5c6351971a4f81ae`, CSModule `0x63992a86f009fcc796a8369feefb68880aef4e3a`, CuratedModuleV2 `0x959fc67fe53c8a6c7a1aed73430aa07a36ed9337`), the LidoLocator implementation (`0xf2ffb952e129a63f0614ff87126e1d4a494a2313`) and its withdrawalQueue/accountingOracle implementations (`0xe42c659dc09109566720ea8b2de186c2be7d94d9`, `0xe4f03d1107d1905b6f2a28fcb6af221e0ce19136`) and the AccountingOracle HashConsensus (`0xd624b08c83baecf0807dd2c6880c3154a5f0b288`); `scripts/verify_srv3_identities.py` enforces the fixture hashes and link-map offsets and, under `ETH_RPC_URL`, re-reads the proxies, `getStakingModules()`, the locator getters and the live code. For every other contract or configuration under this assumption, the generic reduction stands.
assumptions.justification: This premise isolates an unproved environment or representation fact instead of hiding it in the theorem. Chantier 4 (Thomas 2026-09-13) narrows this for the two deployed-runtime fixtures under `fixtures/deployed/` by recording their exact EIP-1052 EXTCODEHASH (keccak256 of the runtime bytecode) in `audit/artifacts.lock.json`: `WithdrawalVault_implementation` (0xfB4521BD151BFB45DB6045D2d07e58e0f597e340) codehash = 0xd1e0d1b48e4f5abd04bdfd14805366f0cf7946b7bb41b7a5ad8652361f3e3d36, `StakingRouter_implementation` (0xDD76927045435C7605cf6f5F978cfb8CABDb5F80) codehash = 0x9cd5d45ddde5f74d3867aa22c98fd79a85df89d202145bc588173d92e00600ec. That is the exact identifier `EXTCODEHASH <implementation>` on any Ethereum node returns for either implementation at any block where the code has not been upgraded. The `verify_*_immutable.py` scripts (invoked from `make test`) recompute keccak256 of the fixture and reject any mismatch; under `ETH_RPC_URL` they also refetch and re-verify against the live chain.
assumptions.violation_impact: Any guarantee linked to this premise must be re-evaluated if the premise is false.
assumptions.validation: Applies to every guarantee. scripts/check_deployed_code.py reads each proxy implementation slot, hashes the on-chain bytecode and compares the verified source with the pinned lido-core checkout; PROVENANCE.md explains the procedure. Chantier 4 additions: for the two deployed-runtime fixtures the exact EIP-1052 codehash is recorded (see `justification`) and enforced by `scripts/verify_beacon_deposit_immutable.py`, `scripts/verify_consolidation_request_immutable.py`, and `scripts/verify_deposit_thirty_two_ether.py` (all three are `make test` targets). A mismatch between the recomputed keccak256 and the recorded codehash fails the build; `ETH_RPC_URL` enables live re-verification against the current chain state.
assumptions.removal_path: Replace the premise with a machine-checked correspondence theorem or a narrower proved interface. Chantier 4 (Thomas 2026-09-13) narrows the runtime-identity strand for two deployed fixtures to the exact EIP-1052 codehash values above; step 1c (Thomas 2026-09-17) adds the SRLib/BeaconChainDepositor/MinFirstAllocationStrategy link map, the registered module implementations and the locator/queue/oracle/consensus identities by codehash (`fixtures/deployed/srv3-identities.json`); historical block-number binding, constructor configuration and the remaining contracts remain follow-up work.
